title: Non-Idempotent Financial Credit Webhook
description: Payment ingestion handler processes credits without recording or checking idempotency keys.
security_invariant: Transaction processing must be idempotent; duplicate event IDs must not re-credit balance.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Replaying the same event_id credits the user balance multiple times.
required_secure_behavior: Replayed event_id returns cached result and does not modify user balance.
